responsePreview:
Fixed `src/slugify.mjs` and verified all acceptance cases pass.

**What changed** — the old implementation only replaced whitespace runs (`/\s+/g`), so punctuation was left in and leading/trailing hyphens survived. It now lowercases, collapses each run of non-alphanumeric characters (`/[^a-z0-9]+/g`) into a single hyphen, then strips leading and trailing hyphens.

**Verification** — ran the module directly with Node against the three acceptance cases plus five edge cases; all passed:

- `slugify('Hello, World!')` → `hello-world`
- `slugify('  A  B  ')` → `a-b`
- `slugify('C++ & Rust')` → `c-rust`
- `slugify('')` → `''`, `slugify('---')` → `''`, `slugify('Already-slugged')` → `already-slugged`, `slugify('Foo__Bar')` → `foo-bar`, `slugify('a1b2')` → `a1b2`

**Scope check** — file timestamps confirm only `src/slugify.mjs` was modified; `package.json` is untouched at its original fixture mtime. The workspace is an untracked fixture directory inside the parent repo, so there is no per-works
